actual: A historical worktree F:\Dev\AIstock_worktrees\private-repo-doc-main-20260519 was bound directly to refs/heads/main while the canonical root was detached at origin/main. The worktree retained an old 2026-05-22 index/worktree snapshot while main advanced to 2026-06-21, producing 1402 staged pseudo changes including deletion of current workflow, Validation Center, MCP, CodeGraph, RA, and Multi-Alpha files. This can make agents misread stale staged changes as valid work and prevents F:\Dev\AIstock from staying on standard main...origin/main. The workflow should forbid non-root task worktrees from using local main and doctor should flag stale-index full-repo pseudo changes before any issue flow continues.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
